# GitScars (`git-scars`)

> A Git-native failure memory and regression guardrail system for software engineers and AI coding assistants.

GitScars captures lessons learned from production incidents, subtle concurrency bugs, and breaking regressions as versioned, human-reviewable Markdown documents anchored directly to repository files, symbols, error signatures, and dependency versions.

When developers edit code or coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot) execute tasks, GitScars deterministically retrieves only the relevant failure memories before mistakes repeat.

- Code Repository: https://github.com/Pavanspoojary/scars
- Website: https://github.com/Pavanspoojary/scars-web
- License: Apache 2.0
- Runtime: Pure Go single static binary (Zero external dependencies)
- Language Support: Native AST symbol parsers for Go (`go/ast`), Python (`ast`), and TypeScript/JavaScript.

## The Core Problem

Monolithic prompt rule files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`) suffer from prompt bloat, attention dilution ("lost in the middle"), and 0% drift detection when files are refactored.
Vector memory and semantic RAG introduce hallucinations, noisy false-positive retrieval, and vulnerability to indirect prompt injection.

## How GitScars Works

1. **Anchored Memory**: Scars bind to exact file paths, AST symbols, error signatures, and test commands.
2. **Deterministic AST Freshness**: Computes SHA-256 digests over symbol AST declarations. Hot edits to comments or imports remain `current`; alterations to function signatures transition to `stale` (exit code 2 in CI).
3. **Fail-to-Pass Verification**: A scar cannot become active without a runnable test verifier that passes on the current worktree and conclusively fails when detached onto the parent base commit.
4. **Human Review Gate**: Scars are human-reviewed and promoted in Git pull requests (`git-scars promote`).
5. **Token-Budgeted Prompt Injection**: Injects compact `<gitscars>` XML guardrails with structured `<dont>` and `<do>` instructions capped to exact token budgets (e.g. `--budget 300`).

## Comparison Matrix

- Monolithic (`AGENTS.md`): 871 avg tokens, unanchored, silent obsolescence on file move, unverified text assertions.
- Glob-Scoped (`.cursor/rules`): 187 avg tokens, directory pattern only, 0% drift detection when files move.
- Vector Memory (RAG): Dynamic tokens, semantic hallucinations, no execution proof, cloud DB dependency.
- GitScars (`git-scars`): 133 avg tokens (-28.9% vs scoped), deterministic AST symbol hashing, scrubbed fail-to-pass test gate, pure Go single binary.

## Key CLI Commands

- `git-scars init`: Initializes `.gitscars/scars/` and local gitignored cache directories.
- `git-scars add --title <str> --lesson <str> --files <path>`: Captures a new draft failure memory.
- `git-scars add from-commit <hash>`: Auto-populates draft from a fix commit.
- `git-scars verify <id>`: Runs double-sided fail-to-pass worktree verification.
- `git-scars promote <id> --status active --reviewer <user>`: Human PR approval gate.
- `git-scars recall --files <path>`: Retrieves relevant active scars for target files or diffs.
- `git-scars inject --files <path> --budget <num>`: Emits token-budgeted prompt guardrails for LLMs.
- `git-scars sync`: Synchronizes active scars into `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`.
- `git-scars triage --error <str>`: Matches raw compiler errors, panic stack traces, and test crashes.
- `git-scars heal -- <cmd>`: Surveillance runner intercepting test crashes and matching scars.
- `git-scars check --format sarif`: CI gate checking AST freshness; emits OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 annotations.
- `git-scars harvest --max 50 --min-confidence 7`: Mines Git history for past bug fixes with co-located tests.
- `git-scars bundle export/import`: Shares curated sets of verified scars across teams without sharing Git histories.

## Document Schema (`.gitscars/scars/<slug>-<shortid>.md`)

```markdown
---
schema_version: "1"
id: "map-write-crash-391945"
slug: "concurrent-map-write-in-telemetry-exporter"
title: "Concurrent map write in telemetry exporter"
lesson: "Metrics map must be protected by sync.RWMutex during RecordMetric calls."
severity: "high"
fix_hint: "Wrap map mutations in mu.Lock() or replace with sync.Map"
bad_pattern: "m[key] = val"
good_pattern: "mu.Lock(); m[key] = val; mu.Unlock()"
applicability: "Telemetry exporters handling concurrent metrics emissions."
anchors:
  files:
    - "pkg/telemetry/exporter.go"
  symbols:
    - "RecordMetric"
  commands:
    - "go test -race ./pkg/telemetry/..."
  error_signatures:
    - "fatal error: concurrent map writes"
verifier:
  result: "fail_to_pass"
  argv: ["go", "test", "-race", "./pkg/telemetry/..."]
  command_hash: "2d4b1ee683d6be106b1633c27fedb692d3f757a5aa049397e28ef1cbd6d52736"
review:
  status: "approved"
  reviewer: "alice"
lifecycle:
  state: "active"
---
```

## Published Technical Essays

- **Prompt Budgets: Scaling Agent Retrieval from 871 to 133 Tokens** (https://pavanspoojary.github.io/scars-web/blog)
  Analyzes how multi-signal anchor scoring (files, symbols, tests, errors) and hard token caps eliminate attention dilution in Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.
- **Automating Regression Memory: From Git Blame to AST Guardrails** (https://pavanspoojary.github.io/scars-web/blog)
  Explains how `git-scars harvest` walks commit history to extract bug fixes with diff-size caps, co-located test filters, and confidence scores >= 7.
- **The Myth of the Monolithic AGENTS.md** (https://pavanspoojary.github.io/scars-web/blog)
  Demonstrates why flat instruction files fail during code moves (0% drift detection) and waste prompt tokens on unrelated subsystems.
- **Why Vector Memory Hallucinates Without AST Proof** (https://pavanspoojary.github.io/scars-web/blog)
  Walks through VibeMemBench (arXiv:2609.23570) and MemSecBench (arXiv:2607.27080) to show why embedding similarity produces false-positive code memories.
- **The Fail-to-Pass Verification Invariant** (https://pavanspoojary.github.io/scars-web/blog)
  Details double-sided worktree verification where tests must fail on the parent base commit and pass on the current tree before activation.

## Quick Installation

```bash
go install github.com/Pavanspoojary/scars/cmd/git-scars@latest
```
